nodes.label: שווי דירה נתניה — Lead Generation Tool
nodes.rationale: Magnet-lead approach: homeowner enters address and property details, receives a value range plus nearby comparable sales, and in exchange for the full report leaves contact details — delivered instantly to the agent via WhatsApp and Google Sheets.
nodes.norm_label: שווי דירה נתניה — lead generation tool

nodes.label: lib/notify.ts — WhatsApp + Google Sheet Notifications
nodes.rationale: Notifications are best-effort: if Green API or Google Sheets webhook are not configured the lead is still persisted to DB.

nodes.label: scripts/harvest.ts — Real Transaction Harvester (Playwright, monthly)
nodes.rationale: Must run headed (visible browser) on a home machine. reCAPTCHA Enterprise scores headless browsers and data-center IPs low and returns HTTP 405; a real visible browser on a residential IP passes cleanly. HARVEST_HEADLESS=true is provided only for testing and is expected to fail in cloud.
